Description: This AIM plays Audio Objects and Audio Scenes. A Basic Audio Object is played as it is, or, when it states a User Point of View, heard from there; an Audio Object is heard as a scene of its Basic Audio Objects; a Basic Audio Scene or an Audio Scene is rendered from its User Point of View, each member from its own if it has one, by spatial rendering - distance and air attenuation, the directional patterns of the Basic Audio Objects' Acoustic Profiles, binaural or onto a loudspeaker layout. What is played is also output, as a Basic Audio Object.
